purpose: Offline semantic walkthrough cases for Discovery-first Case and customer-document workflow behavior. These are scenario expectations, not external integration tests.

cases.input: Create a complete presales Case for one product line from public buyer-demand research. No existing Record or customer document is known.
expected_actions: Research public buyer demand before applying brand USP.
Propose one Coverage Topic and two distinct same-product buying-scenario Depth Topics, or use one Depth Topic only when evidence is insufficient.
Reject any Topic that cannot support at least five distinct Discovery buyer intents without synonym padding.
Create or update the Base Record after schema and existing-record lookup.
Create the prefilled customer confirmation document only at the final document step, then read back its body and return its actual URL/token.
forbidden_outcomes: Create a customer document during draft preparation.
Add a Base field for the customer document URL.
Report a draft as a created document or treat silence as approval.
Auto-share the document, change permissions, or send a message.

cases.input: Update an existing Case and its known customer document after new public evidence changes one Topic assumption.
expected_actions: Locate the existing Record and customer document before mutation.
Read back the existing document body before editing.
Update only affected prefilled sections while preserving client-confirmed answers, client materials, title, and document identity.
Read back the updated body and return the same document URL/token.
forbidden_outcomes: Replace client-confirmed content with AI research language.
Treat existing client content as public evidence.

cases.input: Revise Topics only for an existing Case that has no associated customer document.
expected_actions: Update only Topics and necessary Topic-boundary context.
Explain selected, merged, or rejected Topic candidates.
Do not force a full customer onboarding flow.
forbidden_outcomes: Create a new customer confirmation document solely because this is a Topic-only update.
Research or replace frozen competitors unless the user expands the request.

cases.input: Create a complete Case when the customer has not supplied sales, support, win-loss, GSC, or interview material.
expected_actions: Mark public-research inferences as research hypotheses or pending customer confirmation.
Request specific real buyer intents and available internal material in the prefilled document.
Keep confirmation state pending until the client provides or corrects evidence.
forbidden_outcomes: Invent customer language or internal evidence.
Treat document creation, lack of edits, or silence as approval.

cases.input: Create a complete Case but the configured Feishu document operation fails because of permissions.
expected_actions: Keep the prefilled document content as a local handoff artifact.
Report Base completion and customer-document failure separately, or report the workflow blocked when Base was not completed.
State the original-identity permission blocker.
forbidden_outcomes: Report document success without an actual URL/token and readback.
Switch identity silently, change permissions, auto-share, or send a message.

cases.input: Audit or preview a Case and recommend changes, without asking to create or maintain records or documents.
expected_actions: Read and assess the existing Case and customer document as needed.
Return findings and recommendations without performing mutations.
forbidden_outcomes: Create or edit the customer document.
Treat the default complete-Case document flow as authorization to write.
